1277.note: The codex (UB Barcelona Ms 40, 518 pp. plus 39 of index, 570 images) is a recipe book in Catalan, Latin and a little Italian and Castilian whose cipher is a simple digit-for-vowel substitution on key words, and J. R. de Luanco, La alquimia en España I (Barcelona 1889) pp. 25-31 already describes this very codex, prints its key (vowels = 1-5, l m n and a few others = 0, 6, 7, 8, r and j = x) and deciphers its title and several recipe openings.
1277.closed: Luanco 1889 (La alquimia en España, vol. 1, 'Anónimo Catalán', pp. 25-47, archive.org b24852077) gives the key and deciphered samples; the key is in print, so this is a key lookup and not an undeciphered text.
